name: Forest Pudding
source:
Forest Pudding is a French kinetic visual novel focusing on five young girls trapped in a mysterious forest, a seemingly endless labyrinth of trees that never seem to end... But are things really what they seem? Do the afterimages of their past, the complicated ties that bind them together and tear them apart, take shape in this place? Even if they want to close their eyes to what really happened, perhaps they should never have entered this forest...

[Translated from [url=https://shark-sandwich.itch.io/forest-pudding]itch.io[/url]]
